name: Venus Revolution
original_name: ヴィーナスレヴォリューション
source:
Once per several hundred  years the Gods summon a human to their domain for eight days to study human nature. Main character is such a summoned man. Different Gods represent different elements and main character is given cards representing different elements to use wisely in conversations.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
每隔数百年，众神会把一名人类召到神域，在八天内研究人性。主人公就是被召唤的那个人。不同的神代表不同元素，主人公会得到对应元素的卡片，必须在对话中明智地使用。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
